description: ScriptUI palette create, show (non-modal), event handler, close — auto-closed
source: var clicks=0; var w = new Window('palette', 'TestPalette', undefined); var b = w.add('button', undefined, 'Go'); b.onClick = function(){ clicks++; }; w.show(); w.close(); return {exists: !!w, type: w.type, clicks: clicks};
